centre.ground_height_note: sigma=2 m smoothed DTM at C

local_frame.definition: E = (x - x0)*cos(18.4447 deg), N = y - y0 where x = R*lon_rad, y = R*lat_rad (equirectangular, R=3396190 m); the DTM has 1 m pixels in x/y, i.e. 0.9486 m ground E-W, corrected in every pack file
local_frame.axes_in_pack: x = east, y = up, z = south (image rows increase southward)

height.datum: Heights are those of the DTM product named 'MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid': relative to the Mars geoid (stated in the USGS MSR product README for the same processing; not stated on the 2020 Astropedia page itself)

decode.encoding: 8-bit RGB PNG, no alpha. value16 = (R<<8)|G ; height_m = h_min + value16/65535*(h_max-h_min). B=255 real data, B=0 filled from nearest valid cell. Read with createImageBitmap(...,{colorSpaceConversion:'none',premultiplyAlpha:'none'}).

height-0.png.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)
height-0.png.note: Gaussian sigma 1 m, then sampled at cell centres

height-1.png.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)

height-2.png.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)
height-2.png.note: area-averaged over valid cells; cells with no data filled from nearest valid cell (B=0)

detail-0.webp.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)
detail-0.webp.decode: ratio = 0.5 + value/255 (value 128 = 1.0); ortho / gaussian-blurred ortho (sigma 40 m); read the R channel (lossy WebP can differ by 1 between channels)

detail-1.webp.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)
detail-1.webp.decode: same, blur sigma 600 m; no data = 128

normal-0.webp.pixel_to_local: E = 2080 + (col + 0.5 - width/2)*pixel_m ; N = 1840 - (row + 0.5 - height/2)*pixel_m  (north-up, +x east, +y image-down = south)
normal-0.webp.decode: n = rgb/255*2-1 (renormalise); x east, y up, z south; DTM smoothed sigma 0.7 m

butte_summit.note: chosen as 'Kodiak'; identification NOT verified against a published coordinate
